summary: The AssessmentCombined file is part of a web application that manages student assessments. It includes HTML, ASP.NET controls, C# code-behind logic, and user interface scripts. This file is crucial in rendering an interactive assessment wizard, displaying student and instructor responses, and allowing users to print assessment reports.
purpose: The primary purpose of the AssessmentCombined file is to facilitate the display and management of student assessments through a web interface. It allows users to navigate through assessment steps, view and input responses from both students and instructors, and print assessments in a report format.
